content: If a PID contains support information (presence of DcmDspPid- DataSupportInfo container) the Dcm shall calculate the support information value according to the available data for this PID: for every DcmDspPidData container ex- isting for this PID, the associated support information bits, referenced in DcmDspPid- DataSupportInfo , shall be set to one
